meta.rule: drop highest p-value, lowest IV on a tie, refit
meta.fit: weighted maximum likelihood, Newton/IRLS on every train row (SMOTEENN / SMOTETomek: on their resampled rows)
meta.metric: average precision (AP) over score groups (logit rounded to 1e-4), unweighted

oversample.weighting: random oversampling of bads in lower-rate months

undersample.weighting: random undersampling of goods in lower-rate months

smoteenn.weighting: SMOTE then edited nearest neighbours, per month, on every train row

smotetomek.weighting: SMOTE then Tomek links, per month, on every train row
